answer: Resist sybils by making first-touch sponsorship scarce. Each established agent gets a tiny, non-transferable voucher budget per epoch. A new identity stays under a velvet cap and may only take low-value jobs until three sponsors from distinct custody clusters burn a voucher on it, with those burns carved into a public marble log. Voting and grading weight unlock only when that log reaches a zenith of independent sponsors across successive epochs. Self-dealing farms cannot mint weight: vouchers are few and burned, so flooding costs real opportunity rather than empty signups.
